}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "LM3H", "SiPEED" and "Longan Module 3H" are silkscreened on SoM Module. :"Longhan Pi 3H", "SiPEED" and "LPI3H" are silkscreened on Carrier Board.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Allwinner]] H618 @1.5GHz :SoC: Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A53) *GPU: ''Mali-G31 MP2'', supports :OpenGL ES 1.0/2.0/3.2 *Storage: 32GB (eMMC) Flash, :TF card (max.256GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4) RAM *USB: 2x USB 2.0, 1x USB (Type-C OTG) ports *Wi-Fi: [[AIC]] AIC8800D40L ([[Trolink]] TL8800D4''UA'') :802.11abgn/ac/ax (2.4/5GHz), BT 5.4 BLE *Network: 1x 1GbE port *GPIO: 1x 40-pin connector *Power Source: 5V/2A via USB (Type-C) OTG :or 4-pin Debug UART header
